market_question: Will the price of Bitcoin be above $86,000 on May 18?
reasoning: Bitcoin currently trades near $85,000, making $86,000 an at-the-money strike one year out. In efficient option markets, the probability of ending above an at-the-money strike is approximately 50% before drift, while this market prices only a 0.2% chance, indicating severe mispricing.
evidence_points: Current BTC/USDT spot price is around $85,000, very close to the $86,000 threshold.
One-year time horizon gives substantial room for price discovery; historical log-normal returns suggest a near-50% probability of being above an at-the-money strike.
The implied probability of 0.2% from Yes price of 0.002 is inconsistent with any reasonable volatility assumption for BTC over a year.
